preconditions.description: The length of the input string does not exceed 105 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() or c == '-' for c in input_string)
preconditions.description: The input string consists only of digits and hyphens.

postconditions.description: The output date is in the format 'dd-mm-yyyy' and has exactly 10 characters.
The year in the output date is between 2013 and 2015, inclusive.
The month in the output date is between 1 and 12, inclusive.
The day in the output date is strictly greater than 0.
The day in the output date does not exceed the number of days in the corresponding month.

postconditions.expression: output_date is the date with the maximum count of occurrences among all valid dates in the input string
postconditions.description: The output date is the date mentioned most frequently in the input string.
